narr: A stationary area of showers and thunderstorms occurred ahead of a cold front extending from Lake Michigan down across central Missouri. A small pocket of flash flooding occurred under this stationary cluster of storms.
ev: Several inches of water flowed through a campground in Santa Claus. Roads were flooded in the northern part of the county, including County Road 1600 North near Santa Claus and Monte Casino Road north of St. Meinrad.
lsr: SEVERAL INCHES OF WATER FLOWING THROUGH A CAMPGROUND NEAR SANTA CLAUS. FOUND VIA SNAPCHAT. TIME IS APPROXIMATE.
MONTE CASINO ROAD IS FLOODING NORTH OF ST. MEINRAD.
COUNTY ROAD 1600 N IS FLOODED NEAR SANTA CLAUS.
